title: Brown Rice with Peas and Carrots, No Added Fat

content.title: About
content.content: Brown rice is a whole‑grain product that retains the bran and germ. This version is prepared with peas and carrots without any added fat, making it a low‑calorie, nutrient‑dense dish.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Brown rice provides more fiber and B‑vitamins than white rice.
Peas are a good source of plant protein and vitamin C.
Carrots are rich in beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
Cooking without added fat preserves the natural flavors and reduces calorie count.
Such combinations are traditional in Asian cuisines for balanced meals.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestion, promotes satiety, and helps maintain healthy blood sugar levels.

items.title: Plant‑based protein source
items.content: Peas add a complete set of amino acids beneficial for muscle and tissue health.

items.title: Supports vision
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots is converted to vitamin A, essential for eye health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of added fat makes the dish suitable for calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Rice and peas provide magnesium, phosphorus, and iron, important for overall body function.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peas.

items.title: Phytic acid
items.content: Brown rice contains phytic acid, which can reduce mineral absorption if consumed in excess.

items.title: Moderate glycemic index
items.content: Despite its fiber, rice can still raise blood sugar levels in diabetics; pairing with protein or fat is advisable.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve as a side dish or a main meal. It reheats well in the microwave or on the stovetop, and can be flavored with fresh herbs, lemon juice, or a light sauce.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared product in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑4 days. It can be frozen for up to 2 months. Reheat to at least 75 °C before consumption.
